thread:
jamie.ops: paging oncall — we're seeing a spike of model load failures in us-west-2 serving pool-3. Multiple OOMs during warmup and CUDA driver panics, containers are restarting. Visible 500s to a subset of tenants. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED • P1 • model_warmup_failure_us-west-2 • severity: customer-impact • runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-warmup-failures
katie-sre: acknowledge, I'm on it. grabbing logs + putting pool-3 into read-only routing to stop new requests hitting the nodes.
prateek-eng: logs show repeated deserialize errors for artifact shard-17 before OOM: ```
E deserializer: failed to unmarshal params: invalid varint
E runtime: CUDA driver panic: LRW fault at 0x7f...
E oom: attempted alloc 6.7G but only 512M free
```
lijun-infra: switching routing to fallback-model-vsmall for affected routes now (partial mitigation). also evicting warmup tasks from nodes with >80% mem.
maria-cs: cs asks which customers are affected — we need an initial impact statement for external comms.
jamie.ops: running quick tenant-impact query, will post list.
jamie.ops: (results) 5 tenants saw errors in the last 10m: acme_inc, finlytics, mobile-saas-ops, petram, beta-team-42. Two enterprise customers (acme_inc, finlytics) experienced >=50% request failures.
maria-cs: on it, notifying acct teams for acme_inc and finlytics. ETA for mitigation?
katie-sre: mitigation plan: 1) disable eager warmup on pool-3 2) pin routing to fallback-model-vsmall 3) drain nodes with repeated GPU panics and reprovision 4) increase compile timeout to avoid runaway compile attempts 5) roll back recent model artifact push if correlated. executing now.
prateek-eng: artifact correlation: last artifact publish for the family was 07:12 UTC — hash b3f9a2. There are two suspicious blobs in the artifact bundle that cause protobuf deserialization to loop. I can roll back to b3f6d1 which is known-good.
on-thread (deploy-bot): deploy aborted for model-family/rdw-bert at 07:18 by autoscaler due to health-check fail.
lijun-infra: started drain of node gw-usw2-03, asked cluster-autoscaler to spin up replacements. Marked gw-usw2-04 as quarantine (do not schedule warmup).
jamie.ops: temporary mitigation applied: routing reduced, warmup disabled, fallback model routing in effect. observed error rate drop from 47% -> 12% over 2 minutes.
maria-cs: sending interim update to customers: "We're investigating elevated 500s from model loads in us-west-2; we have applied fallbacks and the error rate is decreasing. Will follow up with root cause and ETA for full restoration."
on-thread (incident-bot): PAGED ONCALL: @katie-sre (ack at 07:20).
oncall: note for handoff: katie requested follow-up from prateek re artifact rollback. handing to jamie.ops at 07:34 due to shift swap. please see active mitigation steps and don't undo the fallback routing until we confirm artifact/driver cause.
katie-sre: handoff summary: suspected causes = corrupt artifact shard + aggressive compile timeout + CUDA driver flakiness under high allocations. Actions taken: routing fallback, disabled warmup, drained/isolated failing nodes, started artifact rollback to b3f6d1 on pool-3.
prateek-eng: rollback in progress. command run: ```bash
./artifactctl rollback --model rdw-bert --to b3f6d1 --pool pool-3 --force
```
prateek-eng: also uploaded a small patch to the deserializer to add an early bail on malformed varints. will coordinate a controlled deploy if rollback doesn't clear things.
jamie.ops: confirmed rollback completed at 07:30 — redeploying model shards from b3f6d1. Monitoring token-level metrics now.
jamie.ops: metrics: request failures for affected tenants now down to ~3-5% and continuing to trend down. GPU driver panic logs stopped after node isolation.
maria-cs: cs updated customers with: "We've rolled back to a known-good model bundle and isolated unstable nodes. We're monitoring and will confirm when fully restored."
customer-success-bot: note added to affected tenant tickets: incident id 3141600000, initial impact note sent.
prateek-eng: post-mortem actions to track: - validate artifact bundle checksums server-side - add stronger protobuf validation before publish - add retry/backoff on compile stage to avoid cascading OOM - add alert if deserializer error rate > 0.1%
lijun-infra: infra action: schedule maintenance window to upgrade CUDA driver on pool-3 nodes (driver 470.x -> 515.x) and enable better driver crash collection.
katie-sre: preparing RCA draft. will include timeline, root cause hypothesis (artifact corruption + driver sensitivity), mitigations, and proposed hardening.
jamie.ops: handoff complete — taking lead for post-incident follow-ups. leaving short runbook snippet here for next oncall: ```
if model load OOMs:
  - switch routing to small/quantized fallback
  - disable eager warmup for pool
  - drain nodes with GPU panics
  - consider artifact rollback to previous bundle
```
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. severity downgraded to P2 at 07:38.
maria-cs: thanks all — will push customer update: full recovery in progress, no data loss, follow-up RCA to come. :white_check_mark:
jamie.ops: closing thread once postmortem is published.
